report.summary: tests/test_containment.py: Contains tests for MIC write containment via daedalus.spine.containment, verifying both refusal and allowance of operations, including move-in attack, junction escape, and bounded inheritance.
risks: CLAIMS|tests/test_containment.py|Every line of the module docstring is an assertion; this file exists to make sure the list stays a measurement rather than becoming a promise
